why: No amine drawn in Figure S1a has formula C7H18N2O2. The two bis(hydroxyethyl) amines drawn (CAS 4439-20-7 and 3197-06-6) are both C6H16N2O2, exactly one CH2 short. Under the VN2/VN3 = ethylene/propylene reading the core would be the propylene homologue of 3197-06-6, which the paper does not draw.

TWO drawn amines have formula C6H14N2: 7154-73-6 (1-(2-aminoethyl)pyrrolidine, one 2-arm site) and 694-83-7 (trans-1,2-diaminocyclohexane, two 1-arm sites). They differ in connectivity and the exact mass cannot see the difference.

Exactly one drawn amine has formula C6H16N2 (CAS 100-36-7, N,N-diethylethylenediamine) and exactly one of its nitrogens carries two hydrogens, so the two arms have only one site. Its +CH2 partner 104-78-9 is also drawn, which is what the measured CH2 ladder predicts.

TWO drawn amines have formula C7H18N2: 104-78-9 (N,N-diethyl-1,3-propanediamine) and 10061-68-4 (N,N'-diethyl-1,3-propanediamine). The CH2 ladder discriminates: VN3C2 = VN2C2 + CH2 to 0.05 mDa, and the linker homologue of VN2C2's core (100-36-7) is 104-78-9, not 10061-68-4.
Exactly one drawn amine has formula C5H14N2 (CAS 109-55-7, N,N-dimethyl-1,3-propanediamine) and exactly one of its nitrogens carries two hydrogens.

The caption labels this VN3C2, but panel (e) already labels a DIFFERENT formula VN3C2 and the two differ by H2. Exactly one drawn amine has C7H16N2 (51387-90-7), but the compound's NAME is unresolved, so it cannot be joined to any value.

NO amine drawn in Figure S1a has formula C4H12N2. This is the paper's LEAD compound (Figures S8, S12, S13 and all in-vivo work). Under the CH2-ladder reading the core is the ethylene homologue of 109-55-7, i.e. N,N-dimethylethylenediamine (CAS 108-00-9) - which the figure does not draw. Figure S1a says 35 amines and draws 34 distinct ones (7209-38-3 twice), so exactly one slot is unaccounted for; that is suggestive and is not evidence.
